This data set contains the eleven (11) scans of the Ice House on Herschel Island. All data was collected by the Capture2Preserv team. The seven (7) exterior scans were collected with the Z+F 5010X laser scanner on the July 07, 2018 and processed and registered with Z+F Laser Control V.8.9.0. The four (4) interior scans were collected with the Leica BLK 360 laser scanner on July 10, 2019 and processed and registered with AutoDesk Recap V. 6.1.
